address: 85 Beilucaoyuan Hutong, Qianmen Street, Dongcheng, Beijing, China Mainland
bio: Inside this seemingly typical courtyard house in an old town back street, the sleek, modern and well-appointed private rooms come as a pleasant surprise. Mansion Xún prides itself on meticulous one-on-one service and set menus that showcase the season's best seafood, like stir-fried white crabmeat. Their signature steamed chicken in scallion oil has gelatinous skin and umami-loaded meat. The couches in the courtyard are the best spot for afternoon tea....
